finance_gate_reasons: Neither sealed Gulf of Nicoya ferry route has a publicly recovered official annual one-way passenger count with explicit passenger and direction semantics.
Neither sealed Panama route has route-specific Guna boarding/operation approval; the official Guna rules instead establish that permission is required.
No primary operator/current timetable/current fare source was recovered for Samaná–Sabana de la Mar.
Samaná–Cayo Levantado has primary current-operation proof but no defensible route passenger volume.
Costa Rica, Panama, and Dominican Republic are absent from country-reference.json at ba48bc5d.
method_rules_applied: No airport, tourism, cruise, whale-watching, or metro-total conversion to route demand.
No passenger inference from vehicle totals.
No splitting of terminal totals across routes.
No doubling or halving of counts without source direction semantics.
No current-operation inference from route geometry.
No city-level DiDi inference from country-level presence.
Null retained wherever primary evidence was insufficient.

source_ledger.publisher: Autoridad Reguladora de los Servicios Públicos (ARESEP), Costa Rica
source_ledger.title: Tarifas del ferry (Cabotaje Mayor)
source_ledger.exact_quoted_fact: Las tarifas del servicio de transporte de pasajeros modalidad cabotaje mayor empiezan a regir el miércoles 1 de julio de 2026.
source_ledger.directionality: Published for each route; no directional price differential is stated.
source_ledger.passenger_vs_vehicle: Passenger fare table; vehicle tariffs are separate and were not used.
source_ledger.benchmark_or_realized_yield: regulated published passenger fare, not realized operator yield
source_ledger.limitations: A fare is usable only with an independently sourced passenger-demand denominator; it does not prove ridership or realized yield.

source_ledger.title: Tipo de cambio de compra y de venta del dólar de los Estados Unidos de América
source_ledger.exact_quoted_fact: 09 jul 2026 — Compra 450,34; Venta 453,77. Fuente: Banco Central de Costa Rica.
source_ledger.benchmark_or_realized_yield: official reference exchange rate, not operator yield
source_ledger.conversion_policy: Use the BCCR venta rate of 453.77 CRC/USD because the model converts CRC passenger fares to USD. USD = CRC / 453.77.
source_ledger.limitations: Converted values are reporting conversions, not operator settlement evidence.

source_ledger.title: Horarios y tarifas
source_ledger.exact_quoted_fact: A partir del 20 de Abril 2026 hasta nuevo aviso
source_ledger.directionality: The page provides separate Puntarenas and Paquera departure columns.
source_ledger.passenger_vs_vehicle: Passenger and vehicle classes are separately listed.
source_ledger.benchmark_or_realized_yield: current-operations proof; published fares are not realized yield
source_ledger.limitations: The operator page does not publish annual route passengers.

source_ledger.publisher: Ministry of Tourism of the Dominican Republic / GoDominicanRepublic
source_ledger.title: Cayo Levantado
source_ledger.exact_quoted_fact: Boat taxis depart regularly from the Samaná port on Avenida Marina, bringing visitors daily to this small island.
